notes: 0.3.3：新增「编译为 EXE」——选中脚本后可编译成独立 exe，机器上不用装 AutoHotkey；官方 Ahk2Exe 与编译底座随包放在 tools/，编译在后台跑、结果与编译器原文回控制台，覆盖同名旧产物自动备份为 .old，不做 UPX 之类加壳。输出位置和文件名改由原生「另存为」框决定，预填名把 .ahk 正确换成 .exe，取消不留痕迹；弹窗与任务结束后自动归还工作集。另把「测试范围与改动范围一致」写进开发指南，发行包新增 tools/ 必需项并补齐第三方分发声明。
notes_en: 0.3.3: Compile to EXE. A selected script now builds into a standalone exe with no AutoHotkey installed on the machine; the official Ahk2Exe and its base interpreter ship in tools/. Compilation runs on a worker, the compiler's rc/stdout/stderr go to the console, an existing target is backed up as .old, and no UPX-style runtime packer is used. A native Save As dialog picks the output path with the name pre-filled by replacing .ahk with .exe; cancelling leaves no trace, and the working set is trimmed after the dialog and the job. The developer guide now states that test scope must match change scope; the release whitelist adds tools/ as a required item and the third-party notices cover the bundled compiler.
